scope: Revisão consultiva da política; testes de integração ainda em curso

request.request: Review a Godot editor addon integration: optional external BlendKit helper must stay disabled unless both this project's boolean permission and the editor preference opt in; headless imports must not initialize the addon UI. User accepted GPLv2 for editor-only use. Review this bounded policy patch, not the whole upstream addon.
request.diff:
New project_policy.gd (@tool extends RefCounted): const CLIENT_PERMISSION: String = "assets2godot/allow_blendkit_client"; static func allows_client(requested: bool) -> bool: var permission: Variant = ProjectSettings.get_setting(CLIENT_PERMISSION, false); return requested and permission is bool and permission == true.
plugin.gd: client_enabled defaults false. _enter_tree() and _exit_tree() return immediately if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless". In init_settings(): client_enabled = ProjectPolicy.allows_client(bool(editor_settings.get_setting(SETTING_CLIENT_ENABLED))). set_client_enabled(enabled): enabled = ProjectPolicy.allows_client(enabled); if enabled == client_enabled: return; client_enabled = enabled; editor_settings.set_setting(SETTING_CLIENT_ENABLED, enabled); if enabled: connection.start(); else: connection.stop(). provider_enabled(key): if key == "blendkit" and not ProjectPolicy.allows_client(true): return false; otherwise upstream visibility. set_provider_enabled clamps BlendKit false when policy blocks. project.godot sets assets2godot/allow_blendkit_client=false. No helper executable in installed nobin package. Export filter excludes addons/assets2godot/* and Assets2Godot/*; cache Git ignored. Local enum renamed State to ClientState in definition and its two consumers, to avoid a global State class collision.
request.tests: Godot 4.7.2 focused test exit 0; TEST: Assets2Godot optional client respects explicit project permission. Covers missing permission, false permission, malformed string false, true+true allowed, true+false denied, plus compilation of client_connection.gd. Full suite still running; no claim of complete pass. Headless editor import exit 0, no script/parse errors, existing shutdown resource warnings.
